name: Antipodean Underwriting
description: Publisher-side underwriting work items: referrals raised off the 41-rule engine, sanctions hits, claims intake and void-override requests. Every task here is created by a flow in the publisher's own account (plan §6.3) except the underwriter's own status moves. See contract artefact 4 (docs/antipodean spec/contracts/04-status-vocabulary.json) for the full status/priority/tag contract this space implements literally.

_notes.record_config_ids: Written alongside record_configs for frontend read-compat only (space-record-configs.utils.ts). model.Space (workspaces-service/model/api.go:98-125) has NO record_config_ids field, so the typed unmarshal on write and the typed read both drop it — contract artefact 4's record_configs_rule. Verification must assert only on record_configs.
_notes.record_configs_scope: Publisher-account configs only (plan §6.1/§6.4). quote_outcome_config, mta_request_config, cancellation_request_config and claim_request_config are distributor-side records living in the distributor's own account/space, not this one. occupation_config and postcode_state_config are rating lookup tables, not task-linked workflow records, so they are not listed here.
_notes.base_record: Points at broker_config (the brokerage contact), not a per-quote or per-insured record, so referral/sanctions/claims/override tasks for one brokerage group under one folder (plan §6.4). identity_fields tries broker_id (the stable business key assigned at onboarding) before falling back to primary_contact_email. A flow creating a task sets `identity: {"broker_id": "..."}` on the create_task/post.task call (model.CreateTaskRequest.Identity, workspaces-service/model/api.go:255-261) to key it.
_notes.statuses: Ids, roles, order and colour are copied verbatim from contract artefact 4 (04-status-vocabulary.json), which is authoritative. `awaiting_broker` deliberately carries no role — A4-2 in that artefact names it the one entry that could be cut, and it is kept for the board and flow 13's ageing per that artefact's decision. `closed` carries role `done` specifically so a task's last action completing does not fall back to Space.FirstCompleteStatusID() and land on `approved`, which would issue a quote (workspaces-service/model/api.go:206-208, handler/task_actions.go:81-84).
_notes.priorities: All five shipped ids declared even though only highest/high/medium have a flow writer — priorities is replace-wholesale on any later write, and dropping low/lowest here would delete them from this space and reassign any task carrying one via priorityMigrationTarget.
_notes.view: view.tasks.board.card.fields per recon-c's build item 1 — the entire board-card surface this space needs (priority icon_and_text, assignees, tags, actions_progress). Not covered by contract artefact 4, which is scoped to status/priority/tag ids only.
